_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The recorder lifetime is used when screen sharing ends during pre-roll. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". window.__recordingMock.endDisplay() ends the screen share as the browser's "Stop sharing" would. The page runs on a fake clock that is already paused when the page loads, at window.__captureStartedAt (epoch milliseconds); steps drive it with window.__clock.runFor(ms) and window.__clock.setFixedTime(ms). Click buttons with click steps on their selectors, never with an eval. Recording uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) answer with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/preroll.webm.json for filenames ending in ".json" and /tmp/shelley-uploads/preroll.webm otherwise; call "metadataDuration" returns the duration_ms of the last metadata (".json") upload's JSON body ("none" before there is one). Message submissions are accepted without being sent on. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. The voice button should be visible; click it.
2. The recording state should become "preroll".
3. Run the clock 100ms (eval "window.__clock.runFor(100)"). The recording state should become "recording".
4. Click [data-testid="recording-screen-button"]. The recording state should become "preroll".
5. Fix the time 1100ms after the capture started: eval "window.__clock.setFixedTime(window.__captureStartedAt + 1100)".
6. End the screen share: eval "window.__recordingMock.endDisplay()".
7. No recording panel should remain (count 0).
8. Call "metadataDuration" must return "1000".
